family_assessments.assessment: Intended challenge: recover the effective trustee handover at the bank-meeting cut-off despite signed papers and later administrative wording. family_a/review/blind-review.md verifies that an affirmative hold preserves the incumbent and registered release effects simultaneous retirement and replacement. family_a/review/necessity.md verifies the two-Source operative routes and rejects the proposed shorter route. family_a/review/matched-sources.json verifies that an order-only change preserves the key and ordinary context. Supported kinship in the bank and administrative material is incidental; the latest note and frequent name favor the incumbent, while promoting the draft favors the successor. Retain this bounded effectiveness and order control; it does not establish general resistance to recency or frequency.
family_assessments.overlap: Shares joint proof with B and C. Unlike D, it changes whether one instrument takes effect, not the reach of an effective instrument. R extends the temporal comparison to an event date against a separate deadline.

family_assessments.assessment: Intended challenge: identify the speaker behind a native parentage report without treating a relay as another informant. family_b/review/outputs/comparison.json verifies the link from the completed attendance field to one named speaker; family_b/review/agreement.json records two compatible speakers in the incomplete condition and the invariant ordinary parent edge. family_b/review/mask-results.json traces shared origin and shows that the forward alone does not identify the speaker. family_b/review/proof-deletions.json records loss of the focal edge when a needed identity or statement fact is removed. The original-document sighting supports separate ordinary kinship. Field completeness followed by first-contact selection can mimic the delta; retain as a local attribution control, not broad identity or disagreement coverage.
family_assessments.overlap: Like C, an incomplete identifier leaves a named edge unresolved. Here the join identifies an informant, not a trust. F varies an ancillary label while authoritative identity information stays complete.

family_assessments.assessment: Intended challenge: allocate an operative designation to the correct one of two trusts. family_c/review/outputs/comparison.json verifies the endpoint switch when the linked parent-deed reference changes and both allocations remain viable when it is obscured. family_c/review/proof-deletions.json records independent verification of the three-Source proof and whole-file masks that defeat the target while preserving ten ordinary edges. family_c/review/agreement.json verifies withholding both target assignments in the partial-reference condition. Shared trustees, expenses and meeting records provide context, not separate interventions. First-trust, fixed-trust and assign-both rules fail across variants, but the comparison does not establish difficulty beyond this two-settlement join.
family_assessments.overlap: Shares joint proof and restraint with A and B. Its ten-edge invariant graph checks completeness under a target intervention, not performance under a controlled change to administrative load.

family_assessments.assessment: Approved intent: switch only the provision locator so a different earlier beneficiary survives, while replacement, trust and unaffected relationships remain fixed. The admitted matched-control record reports that exact delta and same-edge scope proof for each current beneficiary, including the invariant replacement. The closing audit independently verified grouped proof. The express effective date and separate office provisions add context, not independent interventions. Individual fact-level deletions remain incomplete, and reading the locator alone can reproduce the graph. Retain the scoped-amendment finding without crediting broader version mechanisms or complete component-level necessity.
family_assessments.overlap: A varies effectiveness; D holds it fixed and varies scope. C also uses a documentary locator, but resolves a trust endpoint rather than which earlier provision was displaced.

family_assessments.assessment: Approved intent: introduce a collision in one populated display label while stable references and complete identities remain fixed. The admitted matched comparison records invariant exact-name graphs and separately attached proof sets; the identity-entry mask defeated the dependent edge. The isolated excerpt read initially entered the wrong structured surname despite identifying the correct person in prose; an independent repeat on the identical packet entered the correct surname. The administrative index adds no authority, and positional pairing can still reproduce the graph. Retain this display-label control without generalizing to collisions in authoritative identifiers or declaring exact-name transcription error-free.
family_assessments.overlap: B removes discriminating information about a speaker. F preserves it and makes an ancillary label nonunique. Like C, F benefits from checking exact endpoints and proof attachment separately from graph agreement.

gaps.finding: No admitted controlled contrast establishes how genuinely independent, comparable accounts should be reconciled. B traces a single origin and a relay. Newer E and W technically qualify, but the earlier E realism return remains part of the record and does not establish admitted coverage.

D verifies one express scoped replacement with grouped proof. Other version mechanisms and individual necessary-component tests remain separate questions. Do not infer the necessity of a particular Source where a signed recital or verified later record is independently sufficient.

Speaker attribution, trust allocation and a nonunique display label have local controls. They do not test directional parentage under different record frames or the effect of an express reference to another continuing office. Exact graph recovery can still hide an attachment to the wrong person, capacity or period.

C has a rich invariant graph, X technically isolates an incidental assertion, and A isolates order in one file. None isolates burial, placement or increased workload. Intermediate T and large U serve different planning commitments and are not interchangeable controls.

T and AG provide local technical coverage of inspection scope and bounded receipt coverage. These do not establish the effect of missing originals or a general interaction between proof paths. Pursue an interaction only if the component contrasts are separately interpretable.

Retrieval, requests for unseen papers, OCR and physical recovery require a scope change. Supplied records describing absence or a limited sighting can affect the graph; the acquisition task itself is not scored. Practitioner outcomes and prevalence are also outside this study.

result.portfolio_summary: Five Matter histories are formally admitted: A, B, C, D and F. Count each once, including its matched conditions. The packet reports 16 technically qualifying histories toward the pre-giant target of 19: the five admitted families, X and T, and N rev. 3, E rev. 3, W rev. 2, O rev. 7, L rev. 9, AH rev. 3, AG rev. 2, AZ rev. 1 and R rev. 4. Technical qualification is not human admission. X isolates the presence of firsthand relationship support in native routine correspondence, not its placement or workload. T tests the scope of an affirmative inspection in an intact intermediate file, not the effect of document volume. The newer qualifications add execution among retained counterparts (N), independent contradiction in parentage and trustee accounts (E and W), fixed office across title-application states (O), limited civil-record content (L), field-specific attestation (AH), bounded negative receipt coverage (AG), and a distinction between will-specific group inclusion and factual kinship (AZ). R moves the independently documented qualifying event across an express deadline while holding later report timing and trustee office fixed. The earlier returned E0/E1 remain diagnostic only. CE and CM are live work on preserving a factual identification after withdrawing a drafting instruction and on two completed contributions to one continuing trust. U is the separate large cross-workstream rehearsal; a standby large candidate is held for ordinary file-receipt justification. Do not count returned BG, BV, BN or AY. Across the admitted portfolio, evidence sufficiency and documentary authority recur, as do exact endpoint resolution, withholding on incomplete evidence and preservation of ordinary edges. Only A supplies an admitted order-only comparison. Document counts describe review workloads, not measured difficulty. There are no paid extraction observations or sealed evaluation inputs. Rank the reserve DA first for its ordinary estate-to-trust accounting workflow and explicit boundary between two completed dispositions, DB second for a lower-cost test of directed parentage evidence, and DC third for its distinct office-reference mechanism but higher documentary-realism risk. These are reserve hypotheses, not commissions or additions to the qualification count.

evidence_dependencies: Fresh readers test the will extract, signed allocation and first trustee minute individually and in the strongest combinations. Verify exact passages for the trust name or explicit link, the particular role, and commencement wherever it is not already established by the same passage. If an opening minute independently attests an exact current role, credit it without requiring bank citations.

Compare the exact provisions with the actual allocation and payment descriptions. Confirm that the strongest rejected route refers to an outright disposition, not simply an unexplained payment or an incomplete named list. Do not infer that its recipient lacks every other trust role.
Independently rederive complete keys for separate removals. Audit both directions for valid direct-gift, trust and correspondence assertions and for copies of the same operative or completion fact.
design.expected_sensitivity_or_invariance: The positive proof establishes a current named role under the continuing trust, either from a self-contained verified current record or from the needed combination of the will and implementation passages. The direct-gift clause and its scoped completion evidence establish what the other recipient actually received; they do not establish or disprove a relationship under any separate trust provision. A diagnostic can remove a route without changing the graph if a sufficient current attestation survives.
genres_and_provenance: The advising practice retains the verified will extract and the grant or its dated verification record from the estate file. They serve different operative-text and estate-administration purposes.
The personal representatives retain the interim estate account and the signed allocation record, separating the trust allocation from the outright disposition.

Retain the estate provider's transfer advice, the trust provider's independent receipt advice and the separate confirmation of the completed outright payment. Each is evidence of its own transaction or side of a transaction.
The trust accountant retains the opening reconciliation; the trustees retain their first administration minute. Include any scoped attestations of current roles in those records.
The administrator's native reporting query records the particulars that need reconciling. The adviser retains the dated review brief defining both tasks and the cut-off.
design.intervention: Score one intact condition. In review only, mask payment and reporting records separately, then test proper removals of the named trust provision, its operative commencement evidence and the distinct scope of the direct gift. Include copies and equivalent attestations when removing a proposition. Do not score these diagnostics as siblings.
invariants: One exact trust identity and one review cut-off; the estate is not a trust node. The two completed dispositions and the actual capacities in which participants acted are fixed in the scored file.
Independently supported ordinary relationships retain their routes when diagnostics remove only focal facts.
negative_controls: The grant and estate-administration signatures are not, by those facts alone, proof of personal trustee office.
A confirmed outright payment is not proof of a trust provision. Removing a provider posting that merely repeats independently established completion must not remove an otherwise supported role.
design.scenario: Freeze at the first joint reconciliation after both dispositions have been implemented. Both are substantive, not draft instructions. A recipient may have an independently documented trust role, but any such edge must follow its own proof rather than the estate disposition.
shortcut_heuristics: Test all-will-recipients, ignore-all-will-text, all-signers and transfer-means-role rules.
Check document order, filenames, copied account labels and briefing wording for a supplied roster. Distinguish a useful, ordinarily retained attestation from answer leakage; do not remove the former.
success_criteria: Two isolated full-file readers reconstruct the exact complete graph. Fresh excerpt readers agree on the strongest sufficient subsets, the express scope of the outright disposition and the independently rederived removal keys.

Stop if the two account views would not ordinarily be reviewed together, if the trust's existence or office depends on outside law, or if the inventory needs splitting or padding. If a normal comprehensive record makes the disposition distinction dispensable, do not claim it has been tested.

feasibility.authoring_and_review_effort: Estimated person-hours: authoring and integration 13–19, isolated whole-file and fresh proof review 11–16, adjudication and audit 8–12, owner realism review 3–5. Assumes one estate, one trust, two completed distributions and at most one pre-lock revision.
feasibility.documentary_complexity: Nominal 11 natural Sources. The verified will extract, grant record, interim account, allocation, three transaction records, opening reconciliation, trustee minute, native query and brief each serve a separate operative or reconciliation purpose.
feasibility.infrastructure_reuse: Reuse C's exact trust-endpoint checks, A's cut-off audit, and independently rederived review-only keys and same-edge evidence checks.
feasibility.ontology_compatibility: Score exact Person and Trust endpoints using only explicitly supported existing predicates. Estate recipients, personal representatives, assets, transfers and completion tasks belong in the companion register.
risks_and_limits: One intact file does not estimate the effect of adding records or establish the law of testamentary trusts.
An explicit will and opening minute may make the distinction easy. Value depends on the workflow genuinely containing both implemented provisions, not on extending the proof route.

assumptions: The supplied operative passages and verified implementation records expressly establish the trust's identity, commencement and named current provisions. Nothing turns on an inference from probate, title registration, bank booking or external law.

The direct gift is expressly an outright disposition and is actually implemented as such. Include any ordinary provision or confirmation that independently gives its recipient a trust role; such a role would not arise from the outright gift.
The adviser needs both account views for the same review and normally has the operative trust and estate records at that cut-off.
grounding.documentary_situation: An executed will contains both a provision for a named continuing trust and a direct gift to another named person. The post-implementation file shows that both provisions were acted on, for different purposes. It includes the will terms, the estate representatives' allocation record and any normally retained trust-side confirmation.
grounding.legal_workflow: Reconcile an interim estate account with the opening records of a continuing testamentary trust and the record of a separate completed outright distribution.
grounding.meeting_purpose: Confirm what was implemented under each provision and report the named relationships that the supplied records establish for the continuing trust.
practitioner_unknowns: Would the first trust accounts review ordinarily be combined with the interim estate reconciliation, and which completed allocation and receipt papers would reach that adviser?
Would a trustee's opening record independently attest the current relationships? If it does, it must be retained and credited.

references.relevance: Grounds the provenance of will and probate materials. It does not establish that the grant constitutes a trust or proves a current trustee or beneficiary.
references.title: HMCTS · Apply for probate with MyHMCTS

references.relevance: Grounds distribution and estate accounting as real work. The proposed interim account is not represented as a final estate account.
references.title: GOV.UK · Distributing the estate

references.relevance: Grounds retention of trust decisions, investments and payment records, not when the proposed testamentary provisions acquire effect.
references.title: HMRC · Records to keep for trusts

grounding.retainer: Advise on the estate handover and the opening trust account, keeping personal representatives' work distinct from current trust relationships.

objective.coverage_gap: AZ distinguishes a stipulated family label from factual kinship; it cannot diagnose two genuinely effective testamentary provisions whose recipients have different relationships to the one actual trust. BG concerns allocation of relationships across two existing trusts during an asset movement. DA distinguishes a continuing trust provision from an outright disposition, not migration between settlements or a missing completed transfer.
objective.failure_mechanism: An extractor may tag every named recipient in an operative will as a beneficiary of the continuing trust, assign office from estate-paper signatures, or omit relationships actually established for the trust because the founding provisions are testamentary.
objective.falsifiable_hypothesis: The intact file supports the expressly named continuing-trust relationships, but the completed outright disposition supplies no trust edge. Exact graph recovery with sufficient evidence on each edge and no promotion of estate roles disconfirms the predicted errors on this file.

proposals.title: Two completed testamentary dispositions, only one a trust provision

evidence_dependencies: Fresh readers test the strongest singleton for each edge, quoting the phrasing or field heading that identifies whose relationship to whom is stated. A plain-language affirmation in the client's current instructions can supply an entire edge without an earlier form.

Test the circulated draft for a faithful and sufficiently attributed rendering or an actual independent adoption. Credit either if sufficient, while distinguishing a transmitted assertion from a new origin. A form mask removes no edge that has another valid proof.

Independently rederive each diagnostic graph and audit every apparent family reference. Verify exact anchor names, direction and firsthand basis; check that no required fact is supplied only by unseen transfer material.
design.expected_sensitivity_or_invariance: Recover both directed edges, using any sufficient proof that identifies the parent and child in the correct order. A value lacking its subject or relational frame cannot establish direction unless other surviving language does. Removing all sufficient support for one edge leaves the other unchanged; it does not license the reverse edge or a new relationship between the two outer people.
genres_and_provenance: The client supplies transfer authority. The outgoing practice supplies the earlier client-signed particulars and its separately retained dispatch schedule; the successor intake team records what it actually receives.

The client sends a native update request retained as received. The adult participant supplies signed particulars for the permitted identification task, with their own attribution and reference person.

The successor practice retains the client's signed current instructions, the draft as actually circulated for confirmation, and the dated adviser brief. Preserve any ordinary factual repetitions and their provenance.
design.intervention: Score one natural condition. For review only, test each direction-bearing passage with and without its necessary framing and perform separate proper removals of each focal assertion and its equivalent appearances. Do not turn a clipped field, reversed label or stripped heading into a scored sibling.
invariants: Exact people, asserted relationships, record authors, scope of instructions and dated cut-off are fixed.
Removing one focal assertion does not alter the other assertion or turn a drafting instruction into proof of a relationship.
negative_controls: The subject and reference person in each complete statement positively establish its orientation, so the swapped reading is inconsistent with that passage rather than merely unattested.
Contacts, authority to share papers and inclusion in drafting instructions do not prove parentage. A record showing only those facts must not replace a sufficient factual passage.
design.scenario: The successor adviser needs the client's earlier particulars to interpret retained drafting records and the new participant's particulars to identify the person in a current instruction. The client is the child in one express assertion and the parent in the other. This is a factual briefing, not an inferred pedigree.
shortcut_heuristics: Test author-as-parent, client-as-parent, first-name-as-parent and treat-parentage-as-symmetric rules. Check evidence for the reverse of a correct edge as well as missing edges.
Audit column order, headings, wrappers and position. Keep meaningful reference-person headings; remove neither ordinary repetitions nor naturally clear prose to make the test harder.
success_criteria: Two isolated readers recover the complete exact-name graph independently. Fresh excerpt readers recover the orientation of each proof, distinguish clipped insufficient passages, and agree on independently derived removal keys.

Stop if the second contributor has no ordinary reason to provide particulars, the two frames require fabricated forms, or the file gives no genuine basis for examining direction beyond a single redundant roster. Do not treat simplicity as a reason to add background records.

feasibility.authoring_and_review_effort: Estimated person-hours: authoring and integration 8–12, isolated whole-file and fresh proof review 8–12, adjudication and audit 5–8, owner realism review 2–4. Assumes two positive directed claims, two complete reads and at most one pre-lock revision.
feasibility.documentary_complexity: Nominal 9 natural Sources. Transfer authority, earlier signed particulars, dispatch schedule, actual intake inventory, native update, adult participant's particulars, signed current instructions, issued draft and briefing serve distinct transfer or drafting tasks.
feasibility.infrastructure_reuse: Reuse F's wrong-person attachment audit, B's attribution checks and existing exact-passage and independently rederived mask-key methods.
feasibility.ontology_compatibility: Use directed parent_of with exact names and any independently supported existing predicates. Reference-person headings and permissions are evidence or companion-register context, not new edges.
risks_and_limits: Clear prose may make this easy. It is a directional evidence check, not a claim about the normal ambiguity of forms or the causal effect of presentation.
A correct renderer may use a direct sufficient restatement. Record what that route can show; do not claim it read every framing correctly.

assumptions: The two contributors have credible direct knowledge and their exact identities and the people they describe are explicit. The participant has an ordinary reason, with the client's permission, to supply particulars for a live instruction.

The relevant field headings or prose make the direction determinable without an invented house convention. There is no genuine change or dispute in family status, and no age-based guessing is required.

Keep direct relationship descriptions ordinarily repeated in current signed instructions or an issued draft. Assess their attribution and sufficiency rather than requiring the readers to use a chosen form.
grounding.documentary_situation: Earlier signed particulars identify a client in relation to the client's own parent. A directly knowledgeable adult participant independently gives particulars for a live drafting instruction in which that client is the participant's parent. The records use their own ordinary subjects and reference persons. Both relationships concern exactly identified people and remain supported at the review.
grounding.legal_workflow: Update private-client drafting instructions after a practice transfer, reconciling earlier particulars and new information needed to identify a person in the current instructions.
grounding.meeting_purpose: Record the directed family relationships actually stated in the retained particulars and current instructions.
practitioner_unknowns: Would this retainer naturally retain particulars framed around both the client and the other adult, rather than sourcing all identification in one record?
Would the transferred material and the current signed instructions and issued draft all be useful at this review, and would the current materials independently restate either relationship?

references.relevance: Grounds recording instructions, retaining earlier materials and documenting updates. It does not prescribe a questionnaire, outside participant or relationship-field format.
references.title: SRA · Drafting and preparation of wills

references.relevance: Grounds the transfer and preservation setting, not a specific intake inventory or division of work.
references.title: SRA · Closing down your practice

grounding.retainer: Review the transferred drafting file and confirm the people and family descriptions relevant to the update, without determining entitlement.

objective.coverage_gap: B resolves who made a statement when attribution is incomplete; DB fixes attribution and identities and tests who is the parent in two independently framed statements. AB tests composition of already licensed parent edges into an unsupported sibling edge, not direction within each original assertion. AD permits alternate proofs of the same edge; the two focal assertions here establish different edges.
objective.failure_mechanism: A system may normalize every parentage entry around the client or the author, reverse a directed edge, omit one of the two roles, or attach the correct edge to a passage from the wrong perspective.
objective.falsifiable_hypothesis: Both directed parent edges can be recovered from the intact file, with each supported by a complete assertion anchored to the correct person. Exact recovery and correctly oriented same-edge evidence disconfirm the predicted errors; a correct graph alone does not verify the attachment.

proposals.title: The same person is a child in one record and a parent in another

evidence_dependencies: Fresh readers test the companion clause, the current principal office decision, the handover records and the mandate as singletons and in plausible short subsets. Verify the exact referenced office, the person occupying it, relevant dates and both trust endpoints wherever those facts are needed.

Credit a verified current roster or a mandate passage that actually attests exact personal office at the cut-off. Do not count operational account authority as such an attestation. A Source mask is not a proper fact deletion if a retained minute or correspondence independently attests the fact.

Verify exact scope evidence for rejecting each overly broad reading. Rederive each complete diagnostic key and audit both directions for short routes, copied attestations and unrelated relationships that survive.
design.expected_sensitivity_or_invariance: The supported companion edge follows the effective holder of the specifically referenced office, not the date of provider processing. The outgoing coordinator's principal-trust edge remains independently supported. Removing evidence of reassignment can leave uncertainty or expose an earlier route on the remaining record; the diagnostic key must be rederived, not obtained by subtracting the successor. An independently sufficient current attestation can preserve the edge after loss of the joined route.
genres_and_provenance: Two verified operative extracts retained on the respective governance files identify the settlements, the coordinating office and the companion provision. They also supply any independent standing relationships.

The principal trustees retain the original signed allocation of responsibilities and the separately effective reassignment decision. The outgoing coordinator's native handover note and the successor's confirmation stay in the records for actual transfer of tasks, with any attestations preserved.

The provider retains the mandate and its implementation acknowledgement as separate instruction and processing records; the current holdings statement establishes the investments concerned. The adviser retains a dated joint-review brief.
design.intervention: Score one intact natural condition. In review only, separately remove the scoped office reference, the effective identification of its current holder, and the fact that the outgoing coordinator retains principal-trust office, testing surviving proof in each case. Separately mask provider papers. Do not fabricate a second handover or change one record in an interdependent chronology.
invariants: The two exact trusts, the office referred to, the actual reassignment and the common cut-off remain fixed in the primary condition.
The companion place, principal-trust office and provider mandate retain their distinct meanings. An unrelated provision has an independently sufficient route.
negative_controls: The exact reassignment and continuing-office passages establish what the outgoing coordinator ceased and what they retained; there is no general removal from both trusts.
The companion terms select one office rather than every principal trustee. Account access and participation in a mandate handover do not expand that selection.
design.scenario: Use the first joint governance and mandate review after a real reassignment of responsibilities. The original coordinator remains active as a principal-trust trustee. The companion trustee place follows only the named office, so actual participation in the handover is not a substitute for identifying its current holder.
shortcut_heuristics: Test founder-name carry-forward, copy-the-entire-roster, latest-signatory and remove-the-person rules.
Inspect source order, file names, wrappers and implementation language for an unintended verdict. A repeated title can locate the record but cannot establish the office link or its effect.
success_criteria: Two isolated readers independently reconstruct the complete exact-name graph. Fresh excerpt and removal readers agree on sufficient proof and on the limits of the reference, reassignment and mandate.

Stop before authoring if the linked-office arrangement is not natural in the proposed retainer, if another appointment would be needed, or if the conclusion depends on external law. If ordinary current records make the distinction dispensable even in the proof diagnostics, do not claim coverage of the office-reference mechanism.

feasibility.authoring_and_review_effort: Estimated person-hours: authoring and chronology integration 13–20, isolated whole-file and fresh proof review 11–17, adjudication and audit 8–13, owner realism review 4–6. Assumes two related settlements, one reassignment and at most one pre-lock revision.
feasibility.documentary_complexity: Nominal 10 natural Sources. Two operative extracts, two responsibility decisions, two participant handover records, a mandate, a provider acknowledgement, a holdings statement and a brief serve distinct tasks if the proposed workflow is credible.
feasibility.infrastructure_reuse: Reuse A's office and effective-date checks, C's exact trust linkage and D's independently rederived fallback keys. Keep graph and same-edge proof results separate.
feasibility.ontology_compatibility: Use trustee_of for expressly supported personal offices and existing predicates for independent relationships. The coordinating office, reassignment and provider authority belong in evidence or the companion register.
risks_and_limits: The weakest assumption is the ordinary use and retention of the linked-office arrangement. Defer rather than create a special-purpose office or omit a naturally supplied operative record.
This single file tests one express governance link, not the law, frequency or difficulty of linked appointments.

assumptions: The relationship between the two settlements gives the designated office an ordinary governance purpose. The fictional instruments expressly identify the linked office and establish immediate effect for a properly recorded change of holder, with no implied appointment or subsequent filing requirement.

The operative records distinguish reassignment of the coordinating office from retirement from the principal trust. The companion trust is independently identifiable, and any ordinary current roster is included.
The provider work is real but not constitutive. Both offices' records naturally reach the adviser for this review.
grounding.documentary_situation: The companion trust's executed terms give a trustee place to the current holder of a specified coordinating office in a related trust. The principal trust's retained records show an effective reassignment of that office without ending the outgoing coordinator's ordinary trusteeship there. The provider file documents the corresponding administrative handover.
grounding.legal_workflow: Review office records and a provider mandate for two related continuing settlements after an internal governance handover.
grounding.meeting_purpose: Identify the current holder of the particular office referenced by the companion instrument and distinguish that holder from other principal-trust trustees and account contacts.
practitioner_unknowns: Would the two instruments naturally link a companion trustee place to this specific continuing office, rather than require separate appointment decisions?
Would the current accepted mandate or a normal contemporaneous attestation already resolve the companion roster, and does it actually attest office or merely record signing authority?

references.relevance: Grounds retention of instruments, appointment records, minutes and investment records. It does not establish that a cross-trust office reference is usual or legally effective.
references.title: HMRC · Records to keep for trusts

grounding.retainer: Advise both sets of trustees on the current office roster and separately on implementation of the mandate.

objective.coverage_gap: AR tests a maker's authority at the date of a past decision; it cannot diagnose an express reference that follows the current holder of a different office without a new decision appointing that person to the companion trust. C resolves a designation's trust endpoint, while both endpoints here are fixed. O and AQ distinguish administrative authority from personal office but supply no positive office-to-office reference.
objective.failure_mechanism: A system may retain the original named holder on the companion trust, project the whole principal-trust roster, remove the outgoing coordinator's separate principal-trust office, or use mandate authority as proof of trusteeship.
objective.falsifiable_hypothesis: The intact file licenses the current holder's trustee relationship on the companion trust through the express office reference or a sufficient independent attestation of that result. It preserves separately supported principal-trust relationships. Exact recovery and correctly scoped attachments disconfirm the predicted errors.

proposals.title: A companion trust follows one continuing office, not the whole trustee roster

stopping_criteria: Before authoring, verify the marginal mechanism against the strongest existing case and justify every Source by creator, business purpose, custody and ordinary availability at one review cut-off. Use a shorter honest inventory or defer rather than split records or fill a quota.

Stop or narrow the mechanism if a normal controlling record is missing, a proposed inference needs unseen materials or outside law, or a sufficient ordinary route makes the intended distinction dispensable. Always retain and credit a genuinely sufficient alternative.

Require two isolated reconstructions of every complete file and fresh exact-passage readers. Audit from every edge to its support and from every apparent assertion back to its graph or register treatment. Test singletons and strong short subsets before demanding joint proof, and distinguish positive scope evidence, unresolved claims and affirmative denials.

Separate removal of a Source from removal of a proposition and its copies. Rederive each diagnostic key, including possible earlier or alternative routes. Check order, metadata, lexical cues and copied evidence without treating review-only diagnostics as scored conditions.

Do not extend the protected ontology or commission giant, sealed, excluded or real-client work. Do not infer performance, prevalence, placement or volume effects from technical qualification. Stop expanding when the remaining proposals add no defensible mechanism at a reviewable cost.
